assessment: This paper demonstrates that inhibition of TGF-β signalling by simultaneous muscle-specific knockout of TGF-β type I receptors. In particular Tgfbr1 and Acvr1b simultaneously, induces substantial hypertrophy, while such effects do not occur by single receptor knockout. These findings implicate these factors in a synergistic involvement in regulating myofibre size, regeneration and collagen deposition.
